subject: Private VPC deployment \u0014 follow-up & network details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@acmebio.com>, Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.gupta@acmebio.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Private VPC deployment & next steps

Hi Asha / Rajesh,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning  really appreciate the clear description of your security and network constraints. Quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups to help us size the Private VPC engagement: 

- Deployment mode preference: you mentioned wanting a Private VPC (not hosted) with traffic restricted via VPC peering or PrivateLink. Can you confirm which you prefer long-term (VPC peering vs PrivateLink)?
- IP allowlist: please share the egress IP ranges or whether you prefer us to publish a fixed set of egress IPs. If you need an allowlist per environment (staging/prod) let us know.
- Expected traffic: ballpark requests/day and typical request size (avg seq length / tokens) so we can size Dedicated capacity for the peering tunnel.
- Timeline: you mentioned Q2 pilot  what’s your preferred go-live week?

Next steps I propose: I’ll share our Private VPC checklist (networking details + required ACLs) and loop in Vivek (solutions engineer) to review the network diagram with your infra team. Could you also share a simple diagram of your VPCs and whether you control the route tables (so we know if peering will be straightforward)?

Attaching our checklist and an example network diagram for reference.

Thanks  talk soon,

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf (PDF, 58KB), acme-network-diagram.png (PNG, 120KB)

From: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@acmebio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.gupta@acmebio.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private VPC deployment & next steps

Thanks Marissa  great summary.

Quick answers:
- We prefer VPC peering for now (simpler for our networking team). If you need PrivateLink later for cross-account restrictions we can revisit.
- We will need a fixed set of egress IPs to add to our allowlist. Can you provide those ranges or an expected timeline for publishing them?
- Traffic: pilot will be modest  ~10k requests/day, mostly short embeddings and some chat generation (avg 80 tokens/request). Peak concurrency could be 30-40 req/s.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in the week of Apr 19 (flexible by a week).

I’ve attached our internal network diagram (simple) and will loop in our network lead if needed.

Cheers,
Asha
Head of Data Products | Acme Bio
asha.iyer@acmebio.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@acmebio.com>, Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.gupta@acmebio.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private VPC deployment & next steps

Perfect  thanks for the details, Asha. Looping in Vivek to confirm network requirements and to propose the peering configuration. Vivek, see Rajesh and Asha’s notes (attached diagram). Key asks:

- We’ll provide a stable set of egress IP ranges for your allowlist (aiming to publish these within 5 business days once we firm up the peering endpoints).
- For VPC peering we’ll need the VPC ID(s), CIDR blocks, and whether there are overlapping subnets  please ask Rajesh to share those.
- We typically request a dedicated peering connection per environment (staging/prod) to avoid noisy neighbor risk; let us know if that’s a blocker.

Proposed immediate next step: 30-min technical sync between your infra lead and Vivek + Sean next week. When’s Rajesh available?

Thanks,
Marissa

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private VPC deployment & next steps

Hi Asha / Rajesh  thanks for the info and the diagram. Quick technical notes from our side: 

1) Egress IPs: we can allocate a stable set of IPv4 ranges for your allowlist. I’ll confirm exact /28 ranges by EOD Thursday (2027-03-18).

2) Peering details: please share the VPC IDs, account IDs, and CIDR blocks for staging and prod. If you have any overlapping CIDRs we can suggest natting options but peering is easiest when CIDRs do not overlap.

3) Security: we support mutual TLS for service-to-service traffic inside the peered network; if you require HSM-backed keying for any tokens let us know and we’ll route to our compliance team.

4) Proposed schedule:
- Mar 22: 30-min tech sync (Vivek + Sean + Rajesh + Acme infra lead)
- Apr 12-19: pilot readiness (config + test traffic)

Rajesh  are you available for the Mar 22 slot? If yes, please share a calendar invite with your infra lead and we’ll send an invite from our side.

Thanks, Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
